# Reverent Inquiry Change Review

## Change type

- [ ] Maintenance
- [ ] Drift repair
- [ ] Semantic continuity
- [ ] Deployment preparation

## Required restraint checks

- [ ] Frontstage remains freeze-first.
- [ ] No feed, engagement, companion, personalization, or growth behavior added.
- [ ] Admin still feels like quiet maintenance, not an operations console.
- [ ] Browser Air remains ordinary, quietly alive, and low-pressure.
- [ ] GEO / AI-readable changes remain descriptive, not search manipulation.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run guardrail:kernel`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build` only if deployment breakage needs verification
